text.tspan: Wife and I were very open with each other about our pasts during
the dating phase. We were discussing sexual histories and
basically this exact question came up. She had a competition her
freshman year of college with her roommate (a friend of hers)
about who could have sex with the most people that lived in her
dorm by the end of the year. My wife won and put up hall of fame
numbers. She ran it back with another friend her sophomore year
